final_state_at_halt.note: Computed directly from the resume-state snapshot saved at halt (exact CPU/RAM/framebuffer/palette bytes at the instant EXIT fired), not from the .tsv's periodic RAM_HASH_INTERVAL cadence -- the halt (icount 2836207097) does not land on a RAM_HASH_INTERVAL boundary, so the .tsv's own last hash-bearing line is stale by up to one interval. This is the actual 'final frame hash' README's Definition of Victory means. frame_commits shows the last real FRAME_COMMIT was 18,014 instructions earlier (icount 2836189083, frame 2171 of 2172 total) with nothing writing to FRAMEBUFFER/PALETTE in between (dg_hooks.c only writes them from DG_DrawFrame), so this fbhash equals the last rendered frame's.
